display.$description: Display typeface: Titan One, for H1 to H3, button labels, and badges (BR-07). The fallbacks are the email stack (ADR-0058). Titan One has one weight (ADR-0046, TBD-01).

body.$description: Body typeface: Rubik, for body text, captions, form fields, tables, and prices. The fallbacks are the email stack (ADR-0058). Never use the 300 weight (ADR-0047, TBD-02).
